oracle_flags: RUSTC_BOOTSTRAP=1 -Cpanic=abort --cfg rustc_oracle; the oracle links the provider object (--emit=link,obj)
development_note: every rustc, baseline and C2b outcome was declared in scratch before the rustc oracle and the baseline probe ran, and the integrator approved the design and these outcomes before code; this file was frozen after both and before any candidate run. rustc 1.98.0 gave every declared rustc outcome. One baseline prediction missed: slot-unsized was predicted accepted, but the baseline already rejects it at 52 with `nominal type argument must be sized`, because the Sized edge reads imported nominals' parameters; only where-clauses were missing. A local-generic-unbound offset written as 107 was corrected to 111 before any run of that file.
rule: approved design; no wire change. An imported nominal's transported where-clauses are formation requirements in a client, read from the same original inputs selection and coherence read (`Linkage::original_inputs`, every input, outlives omitted) and substituted at the instance's arguments, as a source nominal's `predicates` are. An uncharged formation walk pays the installed header budget exactly the substitution it attempted, once per distinct instance; a charged caller pays through its own closure. C2's negative-coverage workaround `imported_nominal_inputs` is removed, so negative coverage and formation read one source.

outcome_counts.note: 19 declared outcomes: the provider export and 18 clients. rustc accepts six clients and rejects twelve with E0277. On the C3b baseline the seven imported trait-bound opponents are accepted; C2b rejects each at the item its local twin is located at.

native.expected: the six accepted clients exit 42 natively with empty stdout, as rustc's do

observations: baseline (C3b CLI sha256 7cc3e3ef, module-bodies-v13): the provider exports and the six positives are accepted; rc-not-alloc, rc-generic-unbound, rc-field, rc-reference, impl-header, bounded-not-copy and nested-not-alloc are accepted, the gap C2b closes; slot-unsized and the four local twins are rejected exactly as declared for C2b
the local twins locate a signature's failure at its function item, a field's at the field and an impl header's at the impl item; each imported opponent is declared at the same kind of site
limits: a legacy-authority imported nominal (versions 10 and 12) carries no original inputs; if one did, the source payer would refuse it by name (`source validation cannot use legacy header authority`), which the flip survey checks across every provider's older exports
